pages.title: Datapack
pages.text:
A **datapack** is a bundle of data, not code: recipes, loot, world generation. It loads with the world.\
\
The pack loads its own through Paxi; this book is one. Cataclysm x Create and Seasonal Integration are datapacks, and so is the Elytra switch.
